## Overview

Research and development of perception capabilities for autonomous unmanned ground vehicles, combining information from multiple onboard sensing systems for environmental understanding and navigation.

The work included camera and LiDAR-based perception, LiDAR–RGB alignment, semantic segmentation, sensor integration, and the development of perception components for autonomous robotic operation.
